name: QW Share Buttons
author: Himanshu Yadav

sections.description:
QW Share Buttons is a lightweight and fast plugin that adds social sharing buttons to your posts and pages.

Features

  • Inline share buttons (above, below, both, or after the first paragraph)
  • Click-based share counts (counts button clicks on your site)
  • Optional starting count (offset added to click counts for display)
  • Your own share message for each network (WhatsApp, X, Telegram, Bluesky, Threads, Mastodon, Truth Social, SMS) plus email subject and body
  • AI buttons: “Summarize with” ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Perplexity, Google AI and Muse (Meta AI), with a prompt you can edit
  • Optional Google Analytics 4 / Tag Manager “share” event
  • Optional UTM tags on shared links, and short WordPress links
  • Backup and restore: download your settings to a file and load them on another site
  • Statistics page shows clicks by network, and the CSV export has a column for each network
  • “Shares” column on Posts and Pages lists, and clicks by network inside the post editor box
  • Alignment for inline buttons in Button Appearance (Left, Center, Right)
  • Per-post controls in the editor: starting count, hide the buttons, and your own share text
  • Floating side share bar
  • Native “Share” button that opens the phone’s own share sheet (mobile browsers that support it)
  • Sticky mobile bottom share bar
  • Copy link button
  • WhatsApp, Telegram, Facebook, Truth Social, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Bluesky, and more
  • Choose where buttons show: all selected post types, only categories, or specific posts/pages
  • Live preview in Button Appearance (shape, style, size, spacing, labels, colors)
  • Shortcodes: [qwshare_share_buttons] and [qwshare_share_count], with options to pick buttons, link, title and alignment
  • Share statistics and CSV export
  • Dark mode bar, mobile label modes, thank-you message
  • Lightweight and fast: frontend assets load only when needed
  • Accessible share buttons with ARIA labels
  • Works correctly with page cache and Cloudflare (click counts still track)

Important: About share counts

Share counts in this plugin are click-based. They increase when a visitor clicks a share button on your website. They are not official share totals from Facebook, X, LinkedIn, or other networks, and they do not call those network APIs.

Displayed total = Starting count (optional) + click counts on your site.

Shortcodes

  • [qwshare_share_buttons] — display the share bar. Optional settings:
    • id="123" — share a specific post or page
    • networks="whatsapp,x,copy" — show only these buttons, in this order
    • url="https://example.com" — share a different link (a path like /about works too)
    • title="My title" — share this text instead of the post title
    • align="center" — left, center or right
  • [qwshare_share_count] — display the share count only

Privacy

To limit rapid repeat clicks, the plugin may store a short-lived technical key (a hash based on post ID, visitor IP address and browser user-agent) as a WordPress transient. This is used only to prevent count spam, is not sold, and is not used for advertising.

External services

This plugin constructs share links that open third-party social network share dialogs when a visitor clicks a share button. No data is sent automatically by the plugin server-side; the browser navigates (or opens a new tab) to the chosen network’s share endpoint with the current page URL and title.

Services used (when the corresponding network is enabled):

  • WhatsApp (api.whatsapp.com) — opens WhatsApp share with pre-filled text. Terms: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service Privacy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy
  • Telegram (t.me) — opens Telegram share. Terms: https://telegram.org/tos Privacy: https://telegram.org/privacy
  • Facebook (facebook.com) — opens Facebook sharer. Terms: https://www.facebook.com/terms Privacy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy
  • X / Twitter (x.com) — opens post composer. Terms: https://x.com/tos Privacy: https://x.com/privacy
  • LinkedIn (linkedin.com) — opens share-offsite. Terms: https://www.linkedin.com/legal/user-agreement Privacy: https://www.linkedin.com/legal/privacy-policy
  • ChatGPT (chatgpt.com) — AI button; opens ChatGPT with your prompt and the page link pre-filled. Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/ Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/
  • Claude (claude.ai) — AI button; opens Claude with your prompt and the page link pre-filled. Terms: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms Privacy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
  • Grok (grok.com) — AI button; opens Grok with your prompt and the page link pre-filled. Terms: https://x.ai/legal/terms-of-service Privacy: https://x.ai/legal/privacy-policy
  • Perplexity (perplexity.ai) — AI button; opens Perplexity with your prompt and the page link pre-filled. Terms: https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/legal/terms-of-service Privacy: https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/legal/privacy-policy
  • Google AI Mode (google.com) — AI button; opens Google AI Mode with your prompt and the page link pre-filled. Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Muse / Meta AI (meta.ai) — AI button; opens Meta AI (powered by Muse) with your prompt and the page link pre-filled. Terms: https://www.facebook.com/terms Privacy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/
    The AI buttons are ordinary links. Nothing is sent until a visitor clicks one, and then only the prompt text (which includes the page link) goes to that service.
  • Pinterest, Reddit, Bluesky, Threads, Nextdoor, and other networks listed in the plugin settings — each opens that network’s public share/intent URL with the page URL (and sometimes title). Consult each network’s own terms and privacy policy.

No personal data is transmitted by the plugin itself beyond what the visitor’s browser sends when following a normal share link. The plugin does not register with or call network APIs in the background.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload.
  2. Activate QW Share Buttons through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to QWShare in the admin menu to configure networks and display options.
sections.faq:
What does the WeChat button do?

WeChat has no public web share link, so the button copies the page link. Paste it into WeChat to share.

How do I show the share count somewhere else?

Use the shortcode [qwshare_share_count] (optionally with id="123"). It shows the same number as the share bar and updates after a share.

Are these official Facebook / X share counts?

No. Counts track share button clicks on your site only. They are not pulled from social network APIs.

What is the starting count?

An optional number you can set globally or per post. It is added to click counts when showing the total. It is not a claim of external network shares.

Can I set a different starting count per post?

Yes. Edit a post and use the QW Share box in the sidebar.

Can I write my own share message?

Yes. Go to QW Share > Share Messages. Use {title}, {url} and {site}, for example Read this: {title} {url}. Leave a box empty to keep the default wording. X and Telegram add the link by themselves, so leave {url} out for those two. Email has its own subject and body boxes.

What are the AI buttons?

ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Perplexity, Google AI and Muse (Meta AI) buttons. When a visitor clicks one, it opens that AI site with a ready question such as “Summarize this page: (link)”. Turn them on in QW Share > Select Buttons, and change the question in QW Share > Share Messages (AI Buttons Prompt). They are off until you pick them.

Why do the Claude and Muse buttons copy the question?

Claude and Muse (Meta AI) do not always accept a question typed into their link, so they can open with an empty box. When one of these buttons is clicked, the plugin also copies the question to the clipboard and shows a short message, so the visitor can paste it if the box is empty.

How do I move my settings to another site?

Go to QW Share > Advanced Options > Backup & Restore. Click Download Settings File on the first site. On the second site, choose that file under Import Settings and click the button. A wrong file is rejected and nothing changes. Selected categories and posts are specific to each site.

Where can I see which networks are used most?

Go to QW Share > Share Statistics. The Clicks by network list shows your top networks. The CSV export also has one column per network.

What are UTM tags and short links?

In QW Share > Counts & Tracking > Link Tracking. UTM tags add utm_source (the network), utm_medium and an optional campaign name to the shared link, so Google Analytics shows which network sent each visit. Only links to your own site are tagged. Short links share the short WordPress link (like yoursite.com/?p=123) instead of the long address. Both are off by default.

Can I track share clicks in Google Analytics?

Yes. Turn on Analytics Event in QW Share > Counts & Tracking. Each click sends a share event with method (the network), content_type and item_id (the post ID). It uses gtag if your site has it, otherwise the Tag Manager dataLayer. The plugin makes no requests of its own for this.

Can I hide the share buttons on one post?

Yes. Edit the post, open the QW Share box in the sidebar and tick Hide share buttons on this post. This turns off the automatic buttons (inline, floating and bottom bar) for that post only. A shortcode you add yourself still shows.

Can I change the text that gets shared for one post?

Yes. Type it in the Share text field of the QW Share box. It is used instead of the post title in shared messages, such as the X post text, the WhatsApp message and the email subject. Leave it empty to use the post title.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes. You can control mobile visibility and whether labels show as icons only on small screens.

What is the “Share” button?

It opens the phone’s built-in share menu, so visitors can send your page to any app installed on their phone. It uses the browser’s Web Share feature, so it only shows on mobile browsers that support it and only on HTTPS sites. Elsewhere it stays hidden.

What is the mobile bottom bar?

A slim share bar fixed to the bottom of the screen on phones and small tablets. Turn it on under Settings > Mobile Bottom Bar. It uses the first networks from your Select Buttons list and can add the Share button.

Can I show different buttons in different places?

Yes. Add networks to the shortcode, for example [qwshare_share_buttons networks="whatsapp,telegram,copy"]. The buttons appear in the order you type them. You can use x for X (Twitter), fb for Facebook, wa for WhatsApp, tg for Telegram, mail for Email, link for Copy Link and share for the phone Share button. The full list of names is on the Shortcodes page in QW Share.

Can I share a link that is not the current post?

Yes. Use url, for example [qwshare_share_buttons url="https://example.com" title="Our new app"]. Clicks on a custom link are not added to the post’s share count.

How do I place buttons in a custom location?

Use the shortcode [qwshare_share_buttons] in content, widgets (if shortcodes are enabled), or a block that supports shortcodes.
sections.changelog:
1.2.4

  • New: Alignment setting in Button Appearance (Theme default, Left, Center, Right) for inline share buttons. Shortcode align still overrides it.
  • New: “Shares” column on the Posts and Pages lists shows each post’s click count (admin only, uses existing stored counts).
  • New: In the QW Share editor box, a short line lists clicks by network for that post (e.g. WhatsApp 12, Copy Link 5).

1.2.3

  • New: Backup & Restore in Advanced Options. Download your settings to a file and import them later or on another site. A wrong file is rejected and nothing changes.
  • New: Share Statistics now shows “Clicks by network”, and the CSV export has a column for each network.
  • New: Short messages after you reset settings, reset click counts or import settings.
  • Fixed: The Gab, SMS and a few other icons showed the wrong name in a tooltip. Icons are also a little smaller now.
  • Fixed: The buttons under Share Statistics are laid out correctly.

1.2.2

  • New: AI buttons. “Summarize with” ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Perplexity, Google AI and Muse (Meta AI). Pick them in Select Buttons (they are off until you choose them) and change the question in Share Messages.
  • New: Link Tracking in Counts & Tracking. Add UTM tags to shared links, with an optional campaign name, and share the short WordPress link instead of the long one. Both are off by default.
  • New: The Claude and Muse buttons also copy the question to the clipboard, in case the AI site opens with an empty box.
  • Improved: AI buttons open in a normal browser tab, and screen readers read them as “Summarize with ChatGPT” and so on.
  • Improved: The AI sites are listed in the External services section of this readme.

1.2.1

  • New: Write your own share message for WhatsApp, X, Telegram, Bluesky, Threads, Mastodon, Truth Social and SMS. Use {title}, {url} and {site}. Empty boxes keep the old wording.
  • New: Email subject and email body boxes.
  • New: Optional Google Analytics 4 / Tag Manager “share” event when someone clicks a share button (off by default).
  • Fixed: The Email button put the link in the subject and only the title in the body. Now the title is the subject and the link is in the body.
  • Improved: Settings are easier to find. The long “Advanced Options” page is split up: Share Messages has its own menu item, Floating Share Bar is under Where to Display, Dark Mode is under Button Appearance, and all count and Google Analytics settings are under Counts & Tracking. Your saved settings are not changed.
  • Improved: Every settings page now starts with a short plain-language line, and the first page has a 3-step quick start.
  • Improved: Slightly faster page rendering. The finished share bar is no longer cleaned a second time.

1.2.0

  • New: “Hide share buttons on this post” in the editor box. It turns off the automatic buttons (inline, floating and bottom bar) for that post. A shortcode you add yourself still shows.
  • New: “Share text” in the editor box. Type your own text to share instead of the post title.
  • Improved: The editor box is now called “QW Share” because it holds more than counts.
  • Improved: Posts that hide the buttons no longer load the share scripts and styles.
  • Improved: Deleting the plugin also removes the new per-post settings.

1.1.9

  • New: The share buttons shortcode now has options. Use networks to pick which buttons show (and their order), url to share any link, title to change the shared text, and align to place the buttons left, center or right.
  • New: Short names for networks in the shortcode, like x, fb, wa, tg, mail, link and share.
  • Improved: The Shortcodes page now lists every option with examples and all network names.
  • Improved: Smaller plugin download. Removed unused images and unused styles, and made the donation QR image lighter.
  • Fixed: A shortcode that shares a different link no longer stops the post’s own share bar from showing.

1.1.8

  • Fixed: Made-up or unknown network names can no longer be counted, so your database stays clean.
  • Fixed: The share shortcodes no longer show drafts or private posts to people who are not allowed to see them.
  • Fixed: A rare JavaScript error that could happen if the plugin’s settings did not load.
  • Fixed: Post titles with special characters (like &) now appear correctly in shared links.
  • Fixed: Email and SMS share clicks are now counted reliably, even when the page changes right away.
  • Fixed: Clicking a second share button quickly is no longer ignored.
  • Fixed: Very large counts now show as 1M instead of 1000K.
  • Fixed: “Reset all click counts” now removes only this plugin’s data.
  • Fixed: The share bar no longer shows twice when you add the shortcode to a post or when a theme loads the content twice.
  • Improved: The “QW Share Counts” box in the editor now shows on every post type that has buttons or counts.
  • Improved: The reset buttons now use a safer method.
  • Improved: CSV export now includes all your post types, adds a Post Type column, and works on very large sites.
  • Improved: Settings changes apply immediately.
  • Improved: Deleting the plugin on a multisite network now cleans up every site.

1.1.7

  • Added: New “Buttons in Mobile” settings page. Show on Mobile, Mobile Labels, the Mobile Bottom Bar and the Share button options are now together in one place. Your saved settings are unchanged.

1.1.6

  • Fixed: Share buttons now appear automatically (without a shortcode) on more themes and page builders, including block themes.
  • Added: Option to show the Share button on laptops and desktops too (off by default; works in browsers that support it).
  • Improved: Clearer help text under Where to Display, explaining how to select several post types and what each “Show on” option does.
  • Improved: The “Copied!” and thank-you messages are now announced to screen readers.
  • Maintenance: Simplified the copy-to-clipboard code (no change in behavior).
  • Added: FAQ entries for the WeChat button and the share-count shortcode.

1.1.5

  • Scripts and styles now load only on pages where buttons can actually appear (respects post types and Where to Display rules).
  • Fixed: “Count only on” post types can now be cleared completely.
  • Fixed: Email and SMS buttons no longer open an empty popup window.
  • Fixed: the [qwshare_share_count] shortcode now updates right after a share.
  • Share bar is no longer added when a theme or plugin builds an excerpt from the content.

1.1.4

  • Fixed WeChat button: it now copies the page link (WeChat has no public web share URL, so the old link did nothing).
  • Fixed Truth Social icon: the faded background shape now shows correctly instead of at full strength.
  • Allowed extra SVG attributes (opacity, fill-rule, clip-rule, transform) so icons render as intended.
  • Copy Link / WeChat: if the modern clipboard API is denied, fall back to the older copy method so the button still works.

1.1.3

  • Clearer settings labels: Select Buttons, Where to Display, Share Statistics, and Buttons On / Off.
  • Live preview on Button Appearance — see shape, style, size, spacing, labels, and colors before you save.
  • Preview matches the real buttons on your site (same look and brand colors).
  • Choose where buttons show: all selected post types, only some categories, or only specific posts/pages.
  • New Shortcodes page in the sidebar with simple examples.
  • Share buttons no longer appear in feeds, excerpts, or secondary loops.
  • Better accessibility: proper labels on buttons and safer link attributes.
  • Scripts and styles load only when buttons can actually show.
  • Safer cleanup when the plugin is deleted; better support for future updates.
  • Fixed a filter that could pass the wrong HTML for a single button.
  • Removed unused modal code.
  • Mobile visibility uses cache-friendly CSS instead of PHP device checks.
  • Social preview tip handles non-English titles correctly.

1.1.2

  • Fixed rare double-counting when two people shared the same post at the same time.
  • Only published posts are counted (drafts and private posts are ignored).
  • Added a per-IP rate limit so fake or rapid clicks cannot inflate share counts.
  • Shortcodes load their styles earlier so buttons do not flash unstyled.
  • Simpler, cleaner share-count tracking.

1.1.1

  • Share counts work correctly on cached pages (Cloudflare and page-cache plugins).
  • Shortcodes always load their CSS and JS, even on pages or widgets outside the normal settings.
  • Safer counting when many people click at once (no lost clicks).

1.1.0

  • Cleaner admin design: header, tabs, cards, network tiles, and sticky save bar.
  • Native mobile Share button (opens the phone share menu on supported browsers).
  • Optional sticky share bar at the bottom on mobile.
  • Better counting behind Cloudflare and other proxies (new Visitor IP Source setting).
  • Shared-IP visitors are no longer treated as one person when counting.

1.0.0

  • First release of QW Share Buttons.
  • Inline share buttons and a floating side bar.
  • Click-based share counts, starting count, and per-post options.
  • 25+ networks, Copy Link, dark mode, and thank-you message.
  • Shortcodes: [qwshare_share_buttons] and [qwshare_share_count].
  • Share statistics with CSV export.
